bullets.text: Velachery residents faced severe flooding with rainwater and sewage entering homes and submerging vehicles, requiring the office to monitor drainage relief efforts.
A security guard in Tirunindravur died from electrocution after a high-voltage power cable snapped, prompting the office to urge immediate safety checks on exposed electrical lines.
Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay directed all eight in-charge ministers to return to Chennai immediately to oversee heavy rain precautions, which the office must closely coordinate.
Minister R. Kumar inspected northeast monsoon preparedness works in the Adyar zone, and the office should track the progress of these ongoing preventive measures.
Corporation workers successfully cleared waterlogging in Velachery AGS Colony, and the office should watch ongoing municipal pumping efforts across affected streets.
The Okkiyam Maduvu drain project is highlighted as a major gamechanger for South Chennai drainage, and the office should track its implementation timeline.
Heavy rains and waterlogging caused traffic jams and public distress across Thiruvallur and neighboring districts, and the office should monitor relief operations.
The Avadi City Police Cyber Crime Wing arrested a Delhi man over a Rs 1.90-crore boss scam, and the office should review local cyber security enforcement.
A 16-year-old guest worker lost four fingers in a PVC-cutting machine at a Gummidipoondi SIPCOT factory, prompting the office to ensure a thorough safety probe.
Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay and Singapore Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong unveiled CapitaLand's Rs 1,940 crore data centre project in Ambattur, which the office should support.
Infosys plans to hire 20,000 freshers amid AI industry shifts, and the office should monitor employment trends for young graduates in the state.
IISc Bengaluru and the Digital India BHASHINI Division developed AI speech models for the Sourashtra language, which the office should review for digital inclusion.
The DMK criticized Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay for not opposing the SIR or demanding the CEC's removal, and the office should note these political developments.
